slides.body: Shadbala (six-fold strength) is a classical calculation. It scores a planet on position, direction, time, motion, natural strength and aspects.
Each planet has a minimum Shadbala in rupas (units of strength). Divide the planet's total by its minimum. A ratio under 1 means it falls short.

points: High dignity, low ratio: looks strong, isn't
Low dignity, high ratio: quieter but capable
Compare across planets using the ratio

slides.body: Calculating six components by hand for nine planets is slow and error-prone. Software can do it consistently. Judging the result is still yours.
Free AI Shadbala snapshot: see which of your planets truly carry weight.
